name: Fatality VR
summary: Step into the heart-pounding world of Fatality VR. Navigate dark, twisted environments using Gorilla Tag-based movement, complete tense objectives, and escape monsters that stalk your every move. Team up with friends or survive alone as you uncover chilling secrets and unravel a horrifying mystery. Dare to enter the nightmare? Join our Discord for updates: https://discord.gg/e8rNxERx
